snippet.title: Mystery House 3D announcement teaser
snippet.description:
Step into the shadows of Mystery House — a chilling homage of the groundbreaking Roberta Williams classic that gave birth to the graphical adventure genre. What begins as a nostalgic game night among seven friends in an abandoned mansion quickly descends into a waking nightmare as the  house is no ordinary relic of the past. Its walls breathe with secrets. Its rooms are veiled in puzzles. And something — or someone — doesn’t want  you to leave alive.
